_about: Hand-maintained names and plans for Scripts/Maps/render_room_matrix.py. Only facts the ROM cannot give live here. Room ownership for D1-D8/S1-S3 comes from the ROM (z3ed dungeon-room-census --project, dungeon IDs from the bank $0F entrance tables); 'areas' below only names rooms whose dungeon ID is not in Docs/Dev/Planning/dungeons.json. Update 'plans' when Docs/Planning/Status/decisions.org changes.
